title: CAD Draftsperson (Student)
content_text: CAD Draftsperson (Student) - AR Civil Consultancy Services (also known as AR Civil Consultants). Opportunity for students currently pursuing or recently completed a Diploma or Advanced Diploma in Civil Construction Design or other related Engineering fields. Entry-level role to gain practical experience in a professional consultancy while developing AutoCAD and/or Revit skills. Responsibilities: assist in preparing accurate civil and architectural drawings using AutoCAD and/or Revit; interpret design sketches and specifications under guidance; collaborate with engineers and designers to ensure project accuracy and compliance; revise and update drawings based on feedback and design changes. Ideal candidate: enrolled or completed a Diploma or Advanced Diploma in Civil Construction Design or related field; familiarity with AutoCAD and/or Revit; attention to detail and willingness to learn; good communication and time management. Flexible hours and mentorship provided. Apply Now button: mailto contact@arcivilconsultants.com.au with subject 'Application for CAD Draftsperson (Student)'. Firm established 2019, civil engineering drafting, design, building inspections, permit applications, bushfire (BAL) assessments; infrastructure works include road widening and drainage design. Office 3910, Ground Floor, 470 St Kilda Rd, Melbourne VIC 3004. ABN 66 951 546 158. Read 10 Oct 2026 AEDT (headless Chrome and site JS bundle); no posted or closing date shown.
apply_instructions: Email resume and cover letter to contact@arcivilconsultants.com.au with subject 'Application for CAD Draftsperson (Student)' (the careers section's Apply Now link).

title: Graduate Traffic / Transport Engineer
content_text: Traffic / Transport Engineer. onemilegrid has the following positions available: Undergraduate Engineer (penultimate year); Graduate Engineer (<1 year experience); Engineer / Senior Engineer (2-5+ years). The role reports directly to a Director and provides technical support in traffic engineering, transport planning, modelling and analysis, and sustainable transport outcomes; dealing with clients, other consultants, Council, Department of Transport and Planning and other authorities; preparation of transport impact assessments, providing design advice and liaising with clients. Candidate: formal qualifications in Civil Engineering or a related discipline; excellent written and verbal communication; team and independent work, sound judgement. Benefits: training, support, development, exposure to Melbourne projects, inner city location. Applying: send resume with a cover letter to hr@onemilegrid.com.au; in the cover letter tell us about you, your interests and what you can bring to onemilegrid. Only applicants with full working rights in Australia; current Australian drivers licence required. Questions: HR Manager hr@onemilegrid.com.au or (03) 9939 8250. Read 10 Oct 2026 AEDT; no posted or closing date shown.
apply_instructions: Email resume with cover letter to hr@onemilegrid.com.au (the advert's application address).

title: Graduate Engineer - Urban Development
content_text: Graduate Engineer. Location Sunshine Coast, QLD. Full time. 1 position. Job no 9ET7B. Opportunities for Civil Engineering Graduates to join the Urban Development team in the Sunshine Coast office. The Calibre Graduate Program is a two-year integrated experience combining on-the-job learning, professional and technical training, mentoring and development across sectors. Calibre is part of Calibre Group alongside Diona and Sevengen. Requirements: recently graduated with relevant tertiary qualifications in Civil Engineering and 0-1 years of experience; keen interest in Calibre; excellent written and verbal communication; commitment, willingness to learn, deadline-driven environment. All applications should include a resume and covering letter as well as copies of academic transcripts; applications without these will not be considered. Read 10 Oct 2026 AEDT via WebFetch of LiveHire.
apply_instructions: Apply on LiveHire with resume, covering letter and academic transcripts.
